name: Two-Bedroom Flat
author: Companion Intelligence
style: A three-storey walk-up tenement block on a city street, warm yellow stock brick with white sash windows under stone lintels, a pair of stacked canted bay windows, a stone stoop up to the stair core's oxblood street door and a slate hip roof with two dormers and a brick stack; the family's two-bedroom apartment is the whole first floor up, an entry hall and a passage that run back to a study alcove, a living room with a hearth and French doors onto an iron balcony over the street, a bay-windowed dining room, a closed kitchen with a terracotta floor, two bedrooms, a bathroom and a laundry along the back, with a ground-floor flat below and another flat above, both closed behind their blinds, and a walled brick court behind the block
